title: Stanford Pre-Collegiate Summer Institutes
text:
Stanford Pre-Collegiate Summer Institutes is a summer enrichment program that provides intellectually curious students currently in grades 8–11 with intensive study in a single online course.

Stanford Pre-Collegiate Summer Institutes provides participants with an immersive Stanford classroom experience and challenges students with advanced content not typically found in the high-school curriculum.

Choose from over 75 online summer courses that provide in-depth and interactive exploration of academic material. Courses are ungraded and are not awarded credit. Explore courses in subjects such as artificial intelligence, creative writing, engineering, mathematics, philosophy, and more.

With small class sizes, our live online class meetings allow students to engage in every aspect of a course through real-time discussions in which instructors and students see, hear, and interact with one another.

Courses are offered in two sessions per summer. Each session runs for two weeks, Monday–Friday and requires synchronous daily attendance. Note that students may only attend one course per summer.

Participants must be present for all program classes and activities. Participants are required to attend their course at the specified daily class time with their microphone and camera on. Missing more than one class can result in not receiving a certificate of completion.

All activities are designed to provide participants with a well-rounded experience both inside and outside of the classroom. Participants should not have any non-program commitments that directly conflict with required program activities. All courses require asynchronous assignments to prepare for the next day’s class.
